title: •Fozec
caption: •Fozec (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. While Undercover, opponent’s Force drains at related locations are -1. Once during battle, if with an ISB agent, may cause opponent to draw destiny. You may retrieve 2 Force if destiny > 2.
lore: *Spy* for the Empire. Keeping tabs on Jabba’s activities for the ISB. Secretly hoping to leave the Empire and pursue lucrative opportunities in the underworld.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 1 / ABILITY 1, third box blank; slip deploy 2 / forfeit 3 (printed forfeit 2). DS pilot-power icon + '2.' → {pilot:2} (stub expands 'Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots'). Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. Icon column: pilot only. Alien (alien disc on the printed card). The wiki's default 'Fozec' page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text; printed face = 'Fozec (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px JP-D-fozec.gif is a D-E1 errata face (Ke Chu Ke Kukuta? text) — downloaded to src/vs8/33-JP-D-fozec.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan (proper 350×490 scan) is the printed face used as src. Lore corrected: curly apostrophe in Jabba’s; 'Spy' bold — seen bold on the 745 errata face, too low-res to confirm on the 350 printed scan (characteristic rule). Copyright (Jabba's Palace 1998, Hoth-style) — run default, only 'TM & ©' visible. Modern: Virtual Block 3 only (VB3 -pre, 350 px).
